title: Structure Pack Trio #26 (임산부 큰 조각 4개·매끈 / 일반 굵은 스트라이프·물결 / 임산부 비대칭 몬드리안·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Korean, in her mid 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, a poised, refined, confident expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in wavy, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in copper-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of gold a necklace. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. A long hazy transition zone runs diagonally from the upper right edge of her figure to the lower left edge, as seen by the camera. A second transition zone branches off it about 44% of the way along its length and runs to the upper left edge. A third transition zone branches off it about 74% of the way along its length and runs to the lower right edge. Together the three zones divide her figure into 4 large irregular pieces. Region 1 is the piece above the long diagonal and before the second branch (the upper right): it carries applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 2 is the piece above the long diagonal and beyond the second branch (the upper left): it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET and VIVID CYAN panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the piece below the long diagonal and before the third branch (the lower right): it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the piece below the long diagonal and beyond the third branch (the lower left): it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Vietnamese, in her mid 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, soft pastel-lavender hair styled in low bun, real pores, real living eyes, 100 studs piercings set with opals in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing a single piece of gold a bracelet. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 thick diagonal stripes by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 28% of the way down her figure from the top, about 51% of the way down her figure from the top and about 78% of the way down her figure from the top. The stripes alternate between 3 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL-GOLD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP VIOLET radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the diagonal stripe between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, fudo myo-o flames formations in ELECTRIC ORANGE and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is the diagonal stripe between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries rich reddish mahogany wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep red-brown grain with VIVID copper highlight streaks. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: Norwegian, in her late 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real pores, real living eyes, 25 hoops piercings set with diamonds in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold a hair ornament. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 irregular rectangular areas by hazy transition zones running both vertically and horizontally. One vertical transition zone runs the full height of her figure about 52% of the way across her figure from her left edge. To her left of it, a horizontal transition zone crosses about 32% of the way down her figure from the top; to her right of it, a different horizontal transition zone crosses about 72% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is the upper area to her left of the vertical zone, above the left horizontal zone: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC CYAN scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the lower area to her left of the vertical zone, below the left horizontal zone: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL-GOLD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP VIOLET radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 3 is the upper area to her right of the vertical zone, above the right horizontal zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID ORANGE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the lower area to her right of the vertical zone, below the right horizontal zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, tengu feathers formations in DEEP CRIMSON and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
